title: 结构理论中的确定性化：通过闭包、可比性和联合可接受性的统一框架
summary: 本文提出一个形式化框架，用于从多元结构理论构建规范解释。区分三种规范化级别：闭包稳定化、全局完成和确定性化。将非确定性分为认知多元性和结构多元性，并提供两种规范化机制。该框架还应用于LLM辅助推理，将幻觉视为不支持的规范化。
summary_en: This paper proposes a formal framework for constructing canonical interpretations from plural structure theories. It distinguishes three levels of canonicalization and classifies non-determinism into epistemic and structural plurality. The framework applies to LLM-assisted reasoning, viewing hallucination as unsupported canonicalization.
